== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[House]] [[Shen]] is a powerful faction led by the [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]]. Originally known as the [[Shen tribe]], the group was once part of [[House Gray]] before establishing its own identity. The organization possesses significant resources, including a fleet of cloudships, various artifacts, and a large number of [[sacred artists]]. Their influence is anchored by major holdings such as the [[White Lion Bank]], a massive marble [[fortress]] that dominates an entire city and features advanced [[security scripts]] and observational [[constructs]]. [[House|The House]] also maintains a museum in [[Rosegold]] containing rare relics, including rumored [[Abidan]] artifacts. [[Reigan Shen]] is a formidable leader characterized by his white-gold hair and beard. He possesses immense [[Authority|authority]], including control over the [[core binding]] of the [[Slumbering Wraith]] and the ability to manipulate [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]. His leadership is marked by great ambition and a willingness to expend vast amounts of wealth and spatial treasures to achieve his goals, such as hiring the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]] or supporting [[Arelius family|House Arelius]]. Despite their strength and numerical advantages in combat, [[the House]] has faced challenges from opposing forces like the [[Oracle Sage]]. The faction's stability and presence have been impacted by significant conflicts, including the [[destruction]] of their structures and the death of [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[House]] [[Shen]], a group identified by the symbol of a white lion, was brought to the battlefield by [[Yushi]]. While their leaders were occupied with a distant clash occurring on the [[Rosegold continent]], the house engaged in a fight utilizing their artifacts and cloudships. Despite possessing a greater number of [[sacred artists]] than their opponents, the house was ultimately forced into a retreat from the battle.}}
